title: spilanthes bellidioides
intro: Spilanthes bellidioides, commonly known as "Tongue Depressor" or "Toothache Plant," is a flowering plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used to alleviate toothache pain due to its numbing and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, making it a potential therapeutic agent for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Spilanthes bellidioides include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
